AsyncController - Class in org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.ui
JSF Controller class continuously polled during a procedure execution; checks all display queues and user reponses and sets states accordingly.
AsyncController() - Constructor for class org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.ui.AsyncController
 
asyncListener() - Method in class org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.ui.AsyncController
This method is called through ajax by the procedureExecutionPoller component within procedurePerspective.xhtml This is the event loop for asynchronously initiated events This method calls AsyncController.checkUserPrompt() - checks UserPromptMgmt for pending prompts, and displays them if required AsyncController.checkVisualizationDisplays() - checks GraphicDisplayMgmt for pending visualization displays, and displays them if required AsyncController.checkProcedureStatus() - checks for additions to the status log StatusLogController and appends these as required AsyncController.checkFrameDisplay() - checks for new frames to display, marking instructions, etc AsyncController.checkCameraDisplay() - updates the camera display with most recent data AsyncController.checkMessages() - if a procedure exception is detected, displays the procedure abort exeception AsyncController.checkIsWaiting() - waits for user input to a dialog and if exceeds threshold, begins to play annoying reminder sound AsyncController.checkSubProcedureStart() - checks the ProcedureExecutionState if a subprocedure start is requested and sets up user interface to reflect new subprocedure data AsyncController.checkSubProcedureEnd() - checks the ProcedureExecutionState if a subprocedure end is requested and sets up user interface to reflect previous super-procedure data AsyncController.onComplete() - sets up display and state to render the procedure as completed

org.tmt.aps.peas - package org.tmt.aps.peas
Misc top level Beans and Constants: managing all requests and sessions, properties, constants.
org.tmt.aps.peas.common - package org.tmt.aps.peas.common
Utility classes for managing coordinate data, lists of coordinates, encoding coordinates lists to and from string formats that are used to store coordinate lists in a database; the package also contains utilities for generating messages using resource bundles and utilities for generating error and success messages for all cases in PEAS (record update, procedure execution, command execution and generic).

Computation library EJB and computation exception classes.

Computations implemented in Java.
org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.model - package org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.model
Computation result data classes: each class name is unique to a computation so that automated data collection into ProcedureOutput subclasses can be performed without conflict.
org.tmt.aps.peas.config.business - package org.tmt.aps.peas.config.business
Database updates/queries for constants, global configuration, procedure configuration; configuration data caches; real-time configuration of external interfaces.
org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model - package org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model
Data models and database entities for procedure configuration, global configuration, computation configuration, constants and procedure execution preferences.
org.tmt.aps.peas.config.ui - package org.tmt.aps.peas.config.ui
JSF controllers and converters supporting global configuration, sufs zernike orders and missing spots user interfaces.
org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.business - package org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.business

org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.ui - package org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.ui
JSF Controllers for ACS, DCS, Camera and CCD manual and diagnostic user interfaces.
org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.business - package org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.business
CCD Frame file and database reading/writing; Frame simulation; Frame marking utilities.
org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.model - package org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.model
Data classes related to CCD frames; database entities, FITS file data, marking data.
org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.ui - package org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.ui

org.tmt.aps.peas.help.ui - package org.tmt.aps.peas.help.ui
